identification: Three gold-coloured charms, catalogued 9ct: (1) 3D Tower of London (White Tower) charm, square keep with four corner turrets, finely detailed, large jump ring, the classic 1960s-70s English Birmingham-made souvenir charm (some open); (2) 3D wishing well charm with textured roof and bucket/winder, also classic 1960s-70s English; (3) round disc pendant about 20mm with a crab (Cancer zodiac) in relief, rose-gold tone. No hallmarks visible in the one photo.

viewing_check: Look for British hallmarks (anchor, 375, date letter) or 9ct stamps on each charm, inside the Tower base and on jump rings. Weigh all three (combined 8g+ makes it a clear buy at max). Check whether the Tower opens, and whether the well bucket/winder moves. Test the crab disc: 9ct or rolled gold.
